messages:
Sam: Quick question about the onboarding acceptance fallback topology — thinking through the tradeoffs between model-variant fallbacks vs routing to a lightweight local quantized shim.
Tess: high level thoughts: variant fallback is simpler for correctness (same logits shape) but can blow cost if the fallback is large. quantized shim saves $ but needs extra validation.
Raj: Agree. Also important: warm-starting KV cache when we switch to fallback. If the fallback has different embeddings/kvs we get cold token penalty.
Olivia: can we define an acceptance topology graph? e.g. primary -> canary -> small-compat -> quantized-compat -> queued-degraded. That lets us prefer correctness early.
Miguel: That graph makes sense. Concern: telemetry surface. We need per-path metrics: p95 latency, token-cost delta, hallucination rate (eval set), and cache-hit ratio.
Sam: For gating, propose these hard gates: 1) p95 < 120ms addl, 2) eval-quality delta < 2% absolute on golden set, 3) token-cost increase < 35%. If any fail, route to quantized-compat.
Tess: +1. Also add a warmstart budget window: if fallback is used for > 5% of requests in 10m, trigger scale-up or rollback.
Raj: Implementation idea: attach a tiny handshake payload to the first request that contains a small golden probe + kv-hash. Example:
```
handshake: {"probe_id":"onboard-quick-1","kv_checksum":"abcdef12","probe_prompt":"<golden>"}
```
ci-bot: smoke-run/acceptance-prober started for model x-2026-03-20 :hourglass: (job id 9823)
Olivia: That handshake helps us detect mismatch early and populate shared KV cache for cross-variant requests. But it needs encryption at rest — don't leak golden prompts.
Miguel: ops note: if we pre-populate cache we must track TTLs and eviction policy. I recommend LRU with partitioning by model-family so cross-tenant pollution is minimized.
Sam: UX: add an 'acceptance_topology' section to model manifest with ordered fallbacks and per-node: {gate_metrics, warmstart, max_ratio}. Minimal example in manifest:
```
acceptance_topology:
  - name: primary
  - name: quantized-compat
    gate_metrics: [p95, eval_delta]
    warmstart: true
    max_ratio: 0.05
```
Tess: Love the manifest idea. We should also expose an invariant: sum(max_ratio) across degraded nodes <= 0.2 so we don't degrade silently.
Raj: Question: who owns the rollout decision? model-onboard or runtime? I'd push decision logic into runtime (smart routing) and keep manifest declarative.
Olivia: runtime makes sense. product/DS can author the manifest and onboarding tests write the gates.
Sam: Action items:
- Raj: prototype handshake+kv-checkin by EOW
- Miguel: sketch telemetry events and required dashboards
- Tess: add manifest schema PR (small) and policy for sum(max_ratio)
- Olivia: write short runbook for warmstart privacy and KMS notes
ci-bot: smoke-run/acceptance-prober completed: job 9823 :white_check_mark: - 12 probes failed (see run 9823/logs)
Tess: thanks — can someone triage the 12 failed probes? likely KV checksum mismatch.
Raj: I'll pull logs and post root causes in a followup thread. Short term: disable auto-warmstart for that model to avoid noisy fallbacks.
Sam: sounds good. If anyone wants to pair on the manifest PR ping me. :thumbsup:
